## Optional VR feature tests

Set `RC_TEST_FEATURES=rc-engine/vr` when invoking `cargo xtask test-quick` to include the VR unit tests while preserving the workspace dev feature graph. The runner inserts these Cargo features before any libtest arguments. Leave it unset for the original suite. No headset or runtime is required by the unit tests.
